Hi Baldwin,
This is Amin from Avicenna product team. Yes, I share the same name with the Amin you know, but we're different people :). You can call me Amin G moving forward to prevent confusions.
I will be your main point of contact and account manager moving forward. I'm excited to work with you and ensure the successful delivery of your custom solution.
In this email I will outline roadmap of your custom app delivery. We expect your custom app to be delivered by the end of February. If this timeline doesn't work for you, please let me know so we can discuss and adjust the roadmap as needed.
1- Base Custom App: This phase involves creating your customized baseline application, allowing you to collect data except for beat-to-beat intervals and SensorKit data (app usage on iOS devices). Please note that this initial version does not support custom surveys with the social network and locations drop-downs. This phase is estimated to take about two weeks. For this step we'll need some initial resources from you, such as logos, preferred colors, etc.
Once we have the custom app running, we will roll out 3 updates to make the app compliant with your requirements:
2- SensorKit Integration update: The first major update includes integrating SensorKit data to capture app usage data on iOS devices. This requires Apple's permission. We'll prepare all necessary documents, and you'll need to complete some forms, which we aim to submit as soon as possible. Once we receive Apple's ethics approval, an additional week will be necessary to update the app.
3- Geofencing update: This update allows your app to prompt surveys based on geolocations you provide. Participants will see personalized surveys linked to their contacts' geolocations. [I have a query regarding this: Do you require up to 25 geolocations per participant, or is it 25 in total?] This phase will take around 2 weeks.
4- Beat-to-Beat Interval (Heart Rate): In this step, the app will be updated to collect beat-to-beat intervals and deliver JITAIs (Just-in-Time Adaptive Interventions) based on your criteria.
